changeSet.author: TKlok
changeSet.sql:
drop function if exists dbo.CustomSiteNavigation GO
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[CustomSiteNavigation] ( @id int, @NoReadAssetTypes dbo.ids readonly ) RETURNS XML WITH RETURNS NULL ON NULL INPUT AS BEGIN RETURN ( SELECT COALESCE(a.Name,v.Name) as name , v.[Route] AS url , 0 as feature, case when nr.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as disabled, case when v.Object = 'ArtifactType' then dbo.ArtifactSiteNavigation(a.id, @NoReadAssetTypes) when v.Object = 'TaxonomyType' or v.Object = 'PolicyType' then null else [dbo].CustomSiteNavigation(v.id, @NoReadAssetTypes) end as items FROM dbo.SiteNav v left join assettype a on a.objectid = v.objectid and v.Object = 'ArtifactType' and a.[object] = v.[Object] left join @NoReadAssetTypes nr on nr.id = a.id WHERE v.ParentID = @id order by sortorder FOR XML PATH('nav'),TYPE ) END
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[CustomSiteNavigation] ( @id int ) RETURNS XML WITH RETURNS NULL ON NULL INPUT AS BEGIN RETURN ( SELECT COALESCE(a.Name,v.Name) as name , v.[Route] AS url , 0 as feature, case when v.Object = 'ArtifactType' then dbo.ArtifactNgSiteNavigation(a.id) when v.Object = 'TaxonomyType' or v.Object = 'PolicyType' then null else [dbo].CustomSiteNavigation(v.id) end as items FROM dbo.SiteNav v left join assettype a on a.objectid = v.objectid and v.Object = 'ArtifactType' and a.[object] = v.[Object] WHERE v.ParentID = @id order by sortorder FOR XML PATH('nav'),TYPE ) END
